# Bundled dependencies

- GSAP 3.15.0 and ScrollTrigger 3.15.0, GreenSock. Copyright and license notices remain in each bundled script. Standard license: https://gsap.com/standard-license
- Lenis 1.3.17, darkroom.engineering. MIT license in LENIS-LICENSE.txt.
- Archivo Black font from @fontsource/archivo-black 5.3.0. SIL Open Font License in ../fonts/OFL.txt.

These are npm-distributed libraries, not code copied from Aardvark. Regenerate the bundled files with `npm ci` followed by `npm run assets`.
